host_handoff.standalone_behavior: Remain in Glyphbound and report that the Prototype Lab handoff is not connected
host_handoff.connected_behavior: Write PORTAL_RETURN request targeting CENTRAL_HUB, then exit cleanly to the host
host_handoff.native_holoverse_behavior: When mounted through holoverse_dimension_v1, the portal requests the host native return lifecycle in-process; no handoff file or process exit is used.

recovery_rule: Death and explicit world recovery return the player to the safe anchor near the Utopia portal without changing the deterministic world seed.
